summary: Kept the form, relief and massing. Added age: 38 mossy/worn stone-brick cells on the plinth, walls and gate via `mcd paint weather` (new step in make.sh). Cut colour families: gold→cream/andesite, red-brick chimneys→stone, flowers→pink/white/blue, banner→pink/white. Added 7 flank window boxes and removed all 6 orphan blocks, so `mcd check` shows 0 orphans and palette shows no flags. Rendered and looked at all four sides.
applied: Add visible age: mossy and worn variants on the stone brick (38 cells, mostly low on the plinth and walls) via `mcd paint ... weather moderate`. It is reproducible through age.rules and make.sh.

Fewer colour families: bamboo gold sunburst and gable course became cream quartz and polished andesite; brick-red chimneys became stone brick; garden beds dropped red, orange, purple and poppy for pink, white and blue blooms; pennant border changed from yellow to white; porch pot allium became azure bluet.
Small details a player notices: ground-floor window boxes with pink and white blooms under all 7 side-window bays (east and west). The existing lanterns, signs, pots and porch brackets stay.

'Something looks out of place': removed the 6 stray orphan blocks (cap tip arms, roof-crest slabs), trimmed the cone tip to a symmetric finial, and fixed a light-on-light palette flag on the porch gable rays.
skipped: Roof weathering: `weather light` found no visible wear variant on the dark slate roof, so the age is on the stone only.
Awnings: a striped awning would add another colour family against the 'fewer colour families' request, and a painted lady has none. Window boxes and lanterns cover the small-detail request.
Pink and verdigris accents: kept because they are the polychrome identity of the style (pink fish-scale, copper turret cap); only the extra gold, red and yellow were cut.
Brand-new materials for age (vines or concrete decay): skipped, because the blue concrete-powder body has no worn variant and a fresh-painted look suits the style.
